arguments.summary: Technical read through the completed 2026-09-22 session: ANET gained 6.4043%, 8.7676% and 26.5043% over 5/21/63 sessions. Relative to SPY it led by 4.2931/7.7672/21.0789 percentage points; relative to XLK it lagged by 0.4151 point at 5 sessions but led by 1.6976 and 19.9459 points at 21 and 63 sessions. Therefore the short-window evidence is broad-market leadership but slight sector lag, while the 21-/63-session evidence is leadership versus both benchmarks. Price-level trend is strong, but latest-session volume does not confirm a breakout, volatility is elevated, and the 63-session close path included a 15.5060% drawdown. Current-regime historical positive-return frequencies are 55.4517%, 63.8629% and 65.7321% over 5/21/63 sessions; all are below their respective unconditional base rates. These overlapping historical analogs are dependent and are not calibrated forecasts.

claims.text: On 2026-09-22 ANET closed at $205.19, with split-adjusted price returns of +6.4043%, +8.7676% and +26.5043% over 5, 21 and 63 completed sessions. The close was above SMA20 $195.5060, SMA50 $188.3796 and SMA200 $155.89175; SMA20 rose 1.7405% over five sessions. This establishes absolute price-level strength, not benchmark leadership or intrinsic value.

PAIR ANET/SPY 5=+4.2931 21=+7.7672 63=+21.0789
PAIR ANET/XLK 5=-0.4151 21=+1.6976 63=+19.9459
On matched 2026-09-22 SIP-feed, split-adjusted price-return data, ANET outperformed SPY at 5, 21 and 63 sessions. Against XLK, ANET underperformed at 5 sessions but outperformed at 21 and 63 sessions.

The ANET/XLK sign transition from -0.4151 point at 5 sessions to +1.6976 and +19.9459 points at 21 and 63 sessions means the latest five-session advance did not lead the technology sector, even though ANET retained sector-relative leadership over the longer two measured windows. Separately, positive ANET/SPY excess at all three windows shows broad-market leadership. This combination permits a recent sector rebound and established 21-/63-session relative strength to coexist; it does not establish future persistence.

ANET ended 0.1120% below its prior 21-session closing high. Latest volume was 0.9794 times the preceding 20-session median, while average volume over the latest five sessions was 1.3677 times that median. Five-session participation was elevated, but the latest session alone did not provide sustained-volume confirmation of a completed-close move through the prior high.

ANET realized volatility was 22.4371%, 44.8032% and 55.0458% over the 5/21/63-session measurements, versus SPY at 13.6913%/10.3346%/11.4080% and XLK at 17.5525%/22.4178%/28.1332%. ANET's maximum close-path drawdown during the 63-session window was -15.5060%, despite its ending +26.5043% return. These are observations of path risk, not an earnings-risk coefficient or future-loss probability.

Current regime: close above SMA20, SMA20 above SMA50, and positive trailing 21-session return. Historical empirical forward-return analogs were: 5 sessions—55.4517% positive (178/321), median +0.4974%, p10 -7.5762%, p90 +6.7425%, versus unconditional 58.6207% (374/638), median +1.1988%, p10 -7.5914%, p90 +9.7238%; 21 sessions—63.8629% positive (205/321), median +2.8939%, p10 -12.6204%, p90 +15.5652%, versus unconditional 68.3386% (436/638), median +4.7772%, p10 -12.4354%, p90 +19.9845%; 63 sessions—65.7321% positive (211/321), median +10.6427%, p10 -20.6472%, p90 +36.7049%, versus unconditional 75.3918% (481/638), median +13.4654%, p10 -12.5658%, p90 +41.4201%. The forward windows overlap and come from one finite 2023-12-05 to 2026-06-23 history, so observations are dependent historical analogs, not calibrated forecast probabilities. Conditional frequency and median are below unconditional results at every requested horizon.

The continuation case requires preservation of positive 21-/63-session excess returns versus XLK and positive 5-/21-/63-session excess returns versus SPY, ideally alongside repeated completed closes through the prior 21-session high with persistent volume participation. The opposing path is failure near that high, a close below the frozen SMA20, and a recomputed negative 21-session excess return versus XLK; that would weaken the 21-session sector-leadership reading and favor a volatile rebound interpretation. If any regime sign reverses—close above SMA20, SMA20 above SMA50, or positive trailing 21-session return—the reported conditional-frequency analog is no longer applicable to the then-current setup.

assumptions: All comparisons use the completed 2026-09-22 session, SIP feed, split-adjusted prices and price-return basis; they exclude dividends and intraday execution information.
The $195.5060 checkpoint is the frozen 2026-09-22 SMA20, not a future dynamic average or asserted support level.
Historical conditional frequencies are dependent empirical analogs only and are not combined with valuation or fundamental scenarios.
The two-consecutive-session relative-sign rule is an analytical review convention, not an optimized trading rule.
arguments.counter_thesis: The 63-session result shows strong absolute performance and leadership versus both SPY and XLK, but the latest five-session result shows only broad-market leadership: ANET beat SPY by 4.2931 points while trailing XLK by 0.4151 point. Elevated realized volatility, a -15.5060% 63-session close-path drawdown, a finish just below the prior 21-session closing high, and below-median latest-session volume leave room for the advance to become a volatile sector rebound rather than persistent 21-/63-session sector leadership. A close below the frozen SMA20 together with negative recomputed 21-session ANET-minus-XLK excess would materially support that opposing interpretation.

review_conditions.description: If ANET records a completed split-adjusted close below the frozen 2026-09-22 SMA20 level of $195.5060 before expiry, treat the short-term price-level trend as weakened and recompute the three-sign regime; this is a research checkpoint, not an order or future dynamic-average claim.

After each completed session, recompute matched-date 21-session ANET-minus-XLK price-return excess. Two consecutive negative readings would invalidate the current 21-session sector-leadership interpretation and favor rebound participation; continued positive readings combined with repeated closes through the prior 21-session closing high and persistent elevated volume would strengthen continuation evidence. The separate 63-session sign must still be assessed independently.
